author: KEXP
description: London-based artist anaiis radiates warmth with ethereal vocals and soulful soundscapes. Her Live on KEXP in-studio session with host Larry Mizell, Jr. delivers a soothing performance of "Dreamer Too" and more.
title: anaiis performs "Dreamer Too" & more Live on KEXP
